newsitem.title: USA: Tosco has maintenance at crude unit heater.
newsitem.headline: Tosco has maintenance at crude unit heater.

text.p: Tosco Corp is conducting routine maintenance on one of several heaters for the crude unit at its Bayway refinery in New Jersey, a Tosco source said Monday.
The source said the production at the 250,000 barrel per day (bpd) crude unit will be unaffected by the maintenance, which is expected to last three to five days.
"This is just routine maintenance at one of the numerous heaters of our crude unit. It will not affect production in any way whatsoever," said a senior official at the plant.
"The crude unit itself will not go down at all," he added.
